3.1.1.e: Everything told in this अधिकार are known as प्रत्ययाः.
3.1.1.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परम् पञ्चमाध्यायस्य समाप्तिपर्यन्तम् प्रत्ययाः वक्ष्यन्ते ।
3.1.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.2.e: All the words told in this अधिकार are to be attached at the end of the प्रकृति.
3.1.2.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परम् पञ्चमाध्यायस्य समाप्तिपर्यन्तम् ये प्रत्ययाः वक्ष्यन्ते ते प्रकृतेः परः आगच्छन्ति ।
3.1.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.3.v: That which is called an affix has an acute accent on its first syllable.
3.1.3.e: The first स्वर of all the प्रत्ययाः mentioned in this अधिकार becomes उदात्त.
3.1.3.sa: अधिकारोऽयम् । इतः परम् पञ्चमाध्यायस्य समाप्तिपर्यन्तम् ये प्रत्ययाः वक्ष्यन्ते ते आद्युदात्ताः स्युः ।
3.1.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.4.v: The case-affix es (सुप्) and the affixes having an indicatory प (पित्) are अनुदात्त।
3.1.4.e: The first letter of the सुप् and the पित् प्रत्ययाः is अनुदात्त.
3.1.4.sa: सुप्-प्रत्ययानाम्  तथा पित्-प्रत्ययानाम् प्रथमः स्वरः अनुदात्तः भवति ।
3.1.4.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.5.v: After the verbs गुप् , तिज् and कित् comes the affix सन्।

3.1.6.v: The affix सन् comes after the verbs मान 'to honour', बध् 'to bind', दान् 'to cut', and शान् 'to whet', and long ई is the substitute of इ -- सन्यतः [[7.4.79]] of the re-duplicate -- पूर्वोऽभ्यासः [[6.1.4]] syllable.

3.1.7.v: The affix is optionally attached, in the sense of 'wishing' after a root expressing the object wished and having the same agent of the action as the wisher thereof.

3.1.8.v: The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of wishing after a word ending in a case-affix expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher itself.

3.1.9.v: And the affix काम्यच् is also used in the sense of 'wishing' after a word ending in a case-affix, expressing the object wished as connected with the wisher's self.

3.1.10.v: The affix क्यच् is optionally employed, in the sense of treatment after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison.

3.1.11.v: The affix क्यङ् is optionally used in the sense of 'behaving' after a word ending in a case-affix denoting the object of comparison of the agent and there is लोप (elision) of the final स of the noun if it ends in a स।

3.1.12.v: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the crude forms भृश् etc. which do not end with the affix च्वि -- अभूततद्भावे कृभ्वस्तियोगे सम्पद्यकर्तरि च्विः [[5.4.50]], and there is लोप (elision) of the final consonant of these words, if they end in a consonant.

3.1.13.v: The affix क्यष् in the sense of becoming what the thing previously was not, is used after the words लोहित etc. and after those that end with the affix डाच् -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]], when these words do not take the affix च्वि -- अव्यक्तानुकरणाद्द्व्यजवरार्धादनितौ डाच् [[5.4.57]].

3.1.14.v: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of exerting in the dishonesty, is employed after the word कष्ट 'mischief' when the latter has the 4th case-affix in construction.

3.1.15.v: The affix क्यङ् is used after the words रोमन्य 'ruminating' and तपस 'austerity', when they are used as the objects of the action of repeating and performing respectively.

3.1.16.v: The affix क्यङ् is used in the sense of ejecting after the words वाष्प 'vapour' and ऊष्म 'heat' as the object of the action.

3.1.17.v: The affix क्यङ् , in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. शब्द 'sound', वैर 'hostility', कलह 'strife', अभ्र 'cloud', कण्व 'sin' and मेध 'cloud'.

3.1.18.v: The affix क्यङ् in the sense of 'feeling', comes after the words सुख 'pleasure' etc. when the pleasure etc. belong to the agent as feels thereof.

3.1.19.v: The affix in the sense of 'making', comes after these words, as the object of the action, viz. नमस् 'adoration', वरिवस् 'honour', चित्र 'wonder'.

3.1.20.v: The affix णिङ् , in the sense of making, comes after these words as the object of the action, viz. पुच्छ 'tail', भाण्ड 'pot' and चीवर 'rag'.

3.1.21.v: The affix णिच् , in the sense of 'making' comes after these words as the object of action viz. मुण्ड 'shaving', मिश्र 'mixture', श्लक्ष्ण 'soft', लवण 'salt', व्रत 'vow', वस्त्र 'dress', हल 'plough', कल 'strife', कृत 'done' and तूस्त 'matter hair'.

3.1.22.v: The affix यङ् , in the sense of repetition of the act, comes after a root, having a single vowel and beginning with a consonant.

3.1.23.v: The affix वङ् invariably comes in the sense of 'crookedness' after a simple verb expressing motion.

3.1.24.v: The affix यङ् when it is intended to convey the sense of contempt (गर्हा) in respect of the sense of the root (भाव) comes always after the following roots - लुप् 'to cut off', सद् 'to sit', चर् 'to walk', जप् 'to mutter silently any sacred formula', जभ 'to gape or yawn', दह् 'to burn', दश् 'to bite' and गृ 'to swallow'.

3.1.25.v: The affix णिच् is used after these words - सत्य 'truth' (which then takes the form of सत्याप as exhibited in the sūtra), पाश 'a fetter', रूप 'form', वीणा 'a lute', तूल 'cotton', श्लोक 'celebration', सेना 'army', लोम 'the hair of the body', त्वच 'skin', वर्म 'mail', वर्ण 'celebration', चूर्ण 'powder' and the verb of the चुरादि class.

3.1.26.v: The affix णिच् is used after a root, when the operation of a causer is to be expressed.

3.1.27.v: The affix यक् is used after the roots कण्डु 'to itch' etc.

3.1.28.v: The affix आय comes after गुपू 'to protect', धूप 'to heat', विच्छ 'to approach', पण 'to contract or praise' and पन 'to praise'.

3.1.29.v: The affix ईयङ् comes after the sūtra root ऋति 'to reproach'.

3.1.30.v: The affix णिङ् comes after the root कम 'to desire'.

3.1.31.v: The affixes आय and those that follow it i.e. आय , ईयङ् and णिङ् are optionally added, when it is desired to express one's self with an आर्धधातुक affix.

3.1.32.v: All the roots ending with the affixes सन् and others are called धातु ।
3.1.32.e: The words ending in a सनादि प्रत्यय are called 'धातु'.
3.1.32.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.33.v: When ऌ and लुट् follow, then स्य and तासि are respectively the affixes of a verbal root
3.1.33.e: In case of लृट् लकार and  लृङ्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'स्य'. In case of  लुट्लकार, the अङ्ग gets the विकरणप्रत्यय तास्.
3.1.33.sa: लृट् लकारे लृङ्लकारे वा परे धातोः परः 'स्य' विकरणप्रत्ययः आगच्छति  । लुट्-लकारे परे धातोः परः तास् -विकरणप्रत्ययः आगच्छति ।
3.1.33.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.34.v: सिप् is diversely the affix of a verbal root when लेट् follows.

3.1.35.v: आम् is the affix of the verb कास् 'to cough' and of those roots that are formed by affixes i.e. the derivative verbs, when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows, in the मन्त्र।

3.1.36.v: The affix आम् is used when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows after a root beginning with a letter of इच् प्रत्यहार and having a heavy vowel, excepting the root ऋच्छ 'to go'.
3.1.36.e: A verb which can be called as 'इजादिः गुरुमान्' gets an आम् प्रत्यय when followed by लिट्-लकार. However, this प्रत्यय is not seen for the verb root ऋच्छ्.
3.1.36.sa: इजादिः गुरुमान् च यः धातुः, तस्य लिट्-लकारे परे आम् प्रत्ययः भवति । परन्तु ऋच्छ्-धातोः विषये अयं प्रत्ययः न भवति ।
3.1.36.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.37.v: After the words दय 'to give', 'to go' and 'to protect', अय 'to go' and आस 'to sit', there is the affix आम् when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

3.1.38.v: The affix आम् is optionally used after these - उष् 'to burn', विद् 'to know' and जागृ 'to wake', when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.

3.1.39.v: आम् is optionally affixed when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows after these verbs - भी 'to fear', ह्री 'to be ashamed', भृ 'to nourish', हु 'to sacrifice' and when आम् is affixed, the effect is as if there were श्लु elision and the roots belonged to ह्वादि class.

3.1.40.v: After a verb which ends with आम् , the verb कृ 'to do', is annexed when लिट् (Perfect Tense) follows.
3.1.40.e: The लिट्-लकार forms of verb roots कृ, भू, and अस् are applied after the आम्-प्रत्यय.
3.1.40.sa: आम्-प्रत्ययात् परतः कृ/भू/अस्- एते धातवः लिट्-लकारे अनुप्रयुज्यन्ते ।
3.1.40.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.41.v: The form विदाङ्कुर्वन्तु is optionally employed as an irregular form.

3.1.42.v: The forms अभ्युत्सादयामकः प्रजनयामकः चिकयामकः रमयामकः पावयांक्रियाद् विदामक्रन् are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.43.v: When लुङ् (Aorist) follows, the affix च्लि is added to the verbal root.
3.1.43.e: In case of लुङ्लकार, धातु gets the च्लि विकरणप्रत्यय.
3.1.43.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.44.v: Of च्लि , सिच् is the substitute.
3.1.44.e: The च्लि विकरण is converted to सिच्.
3.1.44.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.45.v: After a verb that ends in a शल consonant and has an इक् vowel for its penultimate letter and does not take इट् -- एकाच उपदेशेऽनुदात्तात् [[7.2.10]], क्स is the substitute of च्लि।
3.1.45.e: The च्लि प्रत्यय that follows a शल्-वर्णान्त, इगुपध and अनिट्-धातु is converted to 'क्स.
3.1.45.sa: यः शल्-वर्णान्तः इगुपधः अनिट्-धातुः, तस्मात् परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य क्स-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.45.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.46.v: क्स is the substitute of च्लि after the verb श्लिष , when used in the sense of 'embracing'.
3.1.46.e: When used with the meaning of 'giving a hug', The च्लि-प्रत्यय that follows the verb root श्लिष् is converted to क्स.
3.1.46.sa: 'आलिङ्गनम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे प्रयुज्यमानात् श्लिष्-धातोः विहितस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य क्स-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.46.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.47.v: क्स is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb दृश् 'to see'.
3.1.47.e: For the verb root दृश्, च्लि is not converted to क्स.
3.1.47.sa: दृश्-धातोः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य क्स-आदेशः न भवति ।
3.1.47.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.48.v: After a root which ends in the णि -- पुच्छभाण्डचीवराण्णिङ् [[3.1.20]], -- मुण्डमिश्रश्लक्ष्णलवणव्रतवस्त्रहलकलकृततूस्तेभ्यो णिच् [[3.1.21]], -- च्लेः सिच् [[3.1.44]] etc. and after the verb श्रि 'to serve', द्रु 'to run', and स्रु 'to drop', चङ् is the substitute of च्लि , when लुङ् (Aorist) follows signifying an agent.
3.1.48.e: For the verbs ending in णि-प्रत्यय, and for the verbs  श्रि, द्रु and स्रु, the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to चङ् in the  कर्तरि context.
3.1.48.sa: ण्यन्तेभ्यः धातुभ्यः, तथा च श्रि, द्रु , स्रु-एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य कर्तरि प्रयोगे चङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.48.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.49.v: After the roots धे 'to suck' and श्वि 'to grow', चङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when लुङ् (Aorist) follows signifying an agent.
3.1.49.e: For the verbs धेट् and श्वि , the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to चङ्.
3.1.49.sa: धेट् तथा श्वि धातुभ्याम् परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य विकल्पेन चङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.49.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.50.v: After the verb गुप् 'to protect', चङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.51.v: After the causatives of the verbs ऊन 'to decrease', ध्वन 'to sound', इल् 'to send' and अर्द 'to go or to beg' चङ् is not the substitute of च्लि in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.52.v: After the verbs अस् 'to throw', वच् 'to speak' and ख्या 'to speak', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि , when लुङ् (Aorist) follows signifying an agent.
3.1.52.e: For the verbs असुँ (क्षेपणे), वच्, and ख्या, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
3.1.52.sa: असुँ (क्षेपणे), वच्, तथा ख्या - एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.52.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.53.v: After the verbs लिप् 'to paint', सिच् 'to sprinkle' and ह्वे 'to call', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि when लुङ् (Aorist) follows signifying the agent.
3.1.53.e: For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
3.1.53.sa: लिप्, सिच्, ह्वे - एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.53.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.54.v: After the verbs लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे अङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि when the affixes of the आत्मनेपद follow.
3.1.54.e: For the verb roots लिप् , सिच् and ह्वे , the च्लि-प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of आत्मनेपद.
3.1.54.sa: लिप्, सिच्, ह्वे - एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य आत्मनेपदस्य प्रत्यये परे विकल्पेन अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.54.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.55.v: अङ् is the substitute of च्लि after the verbs पुष् 'to nourish' and the rest; द्युत् 'to shine' and the rest; and the verbs having an indicatory ऌ , when the affixes of the परस्मैपद follow.
3.1.55.e: For the verbs of पुषादिगण and द्युतादिगण, as well as for the ऌदित verbs, च्लि is converted to अङ् when followed by a प्रत्यय of परस्मैपद.
3.1.55.sa: पुषादिगणस्य धातुभ्यः परस्य , द्युतादिगणस्य धातुभ्यः परस्य तथा ऌदित-धातुभ्यः परस्य च्लि-इत्यस्य परस्मैपदस्य प्रत्यये परे अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.55.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.56.v: After the words सृ 'to go', शास् 'to order' and ऋ 'to go', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि in the परस्मैपद as well as the आत्मनेपद ।
3.1.56.e: For the verbs सृ, शास् and ऋ, the च्लि-प्रत्यय is converted to अङ्.
3.1.56.sa: सृ, शास् तथा ऋ - एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.56.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.57.v: अङ् is optionally the substitute of च्लि after that root which has an indicatory इर् , when the परस्मैपद terminations are used.
3.1.57.e: For the इरित्-verbs, the च्लि प्रत्यय is optionally converted to अङ्.
3.1.57.sa: इरित्-धातोः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य विकल्पेन अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.57.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.58.v: And, optionally अङ् is the substitute of च्लि after the verbs जॄ 'to stiffen', स्रुच् & स्लुच् 'to go', मुच् & ग्लुच् 'to steal', ग्लुञ्च् 'to go' and श्वि 'to grow' when the terminations of the परस्मैपद are used.
3.1.58.e: For the verbs जॄ, स्तन्भ्, म्रुच्, म्लुच्, ग्रुच्, ग्लुच्, ग्लुञ्च्,  टुओश्वि - the  च्लि-प्रत्यय is  optionally converted to  अङ्.
3.1.58.sa: जॄ, स्तन्भ् , म्रुच्, म्लुच्, ग्रुच्, ग्लुच्, ग्लुञ्च्,  टुओश्वि - एतेभ्यः परस्य च्लि-प्रत्ययस्य विकल्पेन अङ्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.58.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.59.v: After the words कृ 'to do', मृ 'to die', दॄ (9P) 'to tear' and रुह 'to rise', अङ् is the substitute of च्लि when used in छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.60.v: चिण् is the substitute of च्लि after the verb पद् 'to go' when the affix त follows.

3.1.61.v: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after the verbs दीप् 'to shine', जन् 'to be produced', बुध् 'to teach or know', पूर् 'to be full', ताय् 'to extend or protect' and प्याय 'to smell'.

3.1.62.v: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि , when त - 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद follows after a root which ends with a vowel and when the object itself is spoken of as the agent.

3.1.63.v: चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि after the verb दुह् 'to milk', when it is used reflexively and when त follows.

3.1.64.v: चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb रुध् 'to obstruct' when used in the reflexive sense in the 3rd Person Singular of आत्मनेपद ।

3.1.65.v: चिण् is not the substitute of च्लि after the verb तप् 'to suffer' when used reflexively and when the sense of experiencing remorse.

3.1.66.v: चिण् is the substitute of च्लि when त -3rd Person Singular आत्मनेपद follows, denoting the action (भाव) or the object कर्म्म।

3.1.67.v: The affix यक् comes after a root when a सार्वधातुक -- तिङ्शित्सार्वधातुकम् [[3.4.113]], follows, denoting the action or the object.
3.1.67.e: In the कर्मणि and the प्रयोगे भावे प्रयोग, धातु gets 'यक्' प्रत्यय when followed by a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय.
3.1.67.sa: कर्मणिप्रयोगे भावेप्रयोगे च सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे धातोः यक्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
3.1.67.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.68.v: The affix शप् comes after a root when a सार्वधातुक follows, signifies the agent.
3.1.68.e: A verb gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'शप्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.68.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे धातोः परः शप्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.68.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.69.v: The affix श्यन् comes after a root of the दिवादि class when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting the agent follows.
3.1.69.e: A verb belonging to the दिवादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्यन्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.69.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे दिवादिगणस्य धातोः परः श्यन्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.69.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.70.v: The affix श्यन् optionally used in the active voice after the verbs - भ्राश् 'to shine', भ्लाश् 'to shine', भ्रम् 'to whirl', क्रम् 'to walk', क्लम् 'to be sad', त्रस् 'to fear', त्रुट् 'to cut' and लष् 'to desire'.
3.1.70.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs भ्राश् , भ्लाश्, भ्रम्, क्रम्, क्लम्, त्रस्, त्रुट्, लष्  get the  श्यन् विकरण optionally.
3.1.70.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे  भ्राश्, भ्लाश्, भ्रम्, क्रम्, क्लम्, त्रस्, त्रुट्, लष्  - एतेभ्यः परः श्यन् विकरणप्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
3.1.70.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.71.v: The affix श्यन् is optionally used after the verb यस् 'to strive' when it is used without a preposition and when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent, follows.
3.1.71.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb  यस् when used without an उपसर्ग gets the श्यन् विकरण optionally.
3.1.71.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे अनुपसर्गात् यस्-धातोः श्यन् विकरणप्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
3.1.71.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.72.v: The affix श्यन् is optionally used after the verb यस् 'to strive' when it is preceded by the preposition सम् and when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent, follows.
3.1.72.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb यस् when used with the उपसर्ग 'सम्' gets the श्यन् विकरण optionally.
3.1.72.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे सम्-उपसर्गात् परस्य यस्-धातोः श्यन् विकरणप्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
3.1.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.73.v: The affix श्नु comes after the roots of स्वादि class when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent follows.
3.1.73.e: A verb belonging to the स्वादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्नु' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.73.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे स्वादिगणस्य  धातोः परः श्नु-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.73.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.74.v: And शृ is the substitute of श्नु and there is the affix श्नु after it, when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent follows.
3.1.74.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb श्रु is converted to शृ and it gets the श्नु विकरणप्रत्यय.
3.1.74.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे श्रु-धातोः परः श्नु-प्रत्ययः , तथा श्रु-धातोः शृ-आदेशः विधीयते ।
3.1.74.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.75.v: The affix श्यन् is optionally used after the root अक्ष् 'to pervade' when it is preceded by the preposition सम् and when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent, follows.
3.1.75.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb अक्ष्  gets the श्नु विकरण optionally.
3.1.75.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे अक्ष्-धातोः श्नु-विकरणप्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
3.1.75.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.76.v: The affix श्यन् is optionally used after the root अक्ष् 'to bore or hew' when it is preceded by the preposition सम् and when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent, follows.
3.1.76.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verb तक्ष्  with the meaning 'to peel off / to scrape off' gets the श्नु विकरण optionally.
3.1.76.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे तक्षूँ (तनूकरणे) अस्मात् धातोः श्नु-विकरणप्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
3.1.76.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.77.v: The affix श is used after the roots of तुदादि class, in denoting the agent when a सार्वधातुक affix follows.
3.1.77.e: A verb belonging to the तुदादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.77.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे तुदादिगणस्य धातोः परः श-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.78.v: The affix श्नम् comes after the roots of the रुधादिगणः (7th Conjugation), in denoting an agent when a सार्वधातुक affix follows.
3.1.78.e: A verb belonging to the रुधादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्नम्' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.78.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे रुधादिगणस्य धातोः परः श्नम्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.79.v: The affix उ comes after the roots of the तनादिगणः (8th Conjugation) and after the verb कृ 'to make', when a सार्वधातुक affix follows, signifying the agent.
3.1.79.e: A verb belonging to the तनादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'उ' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.79.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे तनादिगणस्य धातोः परः उ-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.79.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.80.v: The affix उ comes after the roots धिन्व 'to please' and कृणिव 'to hurt', when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting the agent follows and in these verbs अ is the final substitute of the final इ।
3.1.80.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs धिन्व्, कृण्व् gets the 'उ' विकरणप्रत्यय.
3.1.80.sa: कर्तरि सार्वधातुके प्रत्यये परे धिन्व्-धातोः कृण्व्-धातोः उ-प्रत्ययः भवति, अङ्गस्य च अकारादेशः भवति ।
3.1.80.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.81.v: The affix श्ना comes after the roots of the क्र्यादिगणः (9th Conjugation) when a सार्वधातुक affix follows denoting the agent.
3.1.81.e: A verb belonging to the क्र्यादिगण gets the विकरणप्रत्यय 'श्ना' in presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in कर्तरि प्रयोग.
3.1.81.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे क्र्यादिगणस्य धातोः परः श्ना-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
3.1.81.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.82.v: And there is the affix श्ना after स्तम्भ , स्तुम्भ , स्कम्भ or स्कुम्भ 'to hinder', to be dull or insensible' 'to support' and स्कु 'to go by leaps', as well as the affix श्नु , when a सार्वधातुक affix follows, in denoting the agent. (Note: The first 4 धातु are not found in the धातुपाठ and are found in the sūtras, and hence called सौत्र धातु ।)
3.1.82.e: In presence of a सार्वधातुक प्रत्यय in the कर्तरि प्रयोग, the verbs  स्तम्भ्, स्तुम्भ्, स्कम्भ्, स्कुम्भ्, स्कुञ् gets the श्ना or the श्नु विकरणप्रत्यय.
3.1.82.sa: सार्वधातुके कर्तरि प्रत्यये परे स्तम्भ्, स्तुम्भ्, स्कम्भ्, स्कुम्भ्, स्कुञ् - एतेभ्यः श्ना तथा श्नु प्रत्ययौ भवतः ।
3.1.82.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.83.v: The affix शानच् is the substitute of श्ना after a root ending with a consonant, when हि follows.
3.1.83.e: The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is converted to शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.
3.1.83.sa: हलन्तात् परस्य श्ना-प्रत्ययस्य हि-प्रत्यये परे शानच्-आदेशः भवति ।
3.1.83.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.84.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), शायच् is also the substitute of श्ना after the roots ending in consonants, when हि follows.
3.1.84.e: The श्ना प्रत्यय following a हल् letter is seen converted either to शायच् or शानच् when followed by the 'हि' प्रत्यय.
3.1.84.sa: वेदानां विषये - श्ना-प्रत्ययस्य हि-प्रत्यये परे  शानच् तथा शायच् उभौ अपि आदेशौ भवतः ।
3.1.84.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.85.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely an interchange of the various विकरण-as शप् etc. which have been previously ordained under special circumstances.
3.1.85.e: In the context of वेदाः - Some kind of irregularity might be seen with reference to application of विकरणप्रत्ययाः
3.1.85.sa: वेदानां विषये - गणविकरणस्य प्रयोगे बहुलं व्यत्ययः भवति ।
3.1.85.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.86.v: The affix अङ् is used in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when the affixes of the आशीर्लिङ् (Benedictive) follow.
3.1.86.e: In the context of वेदाः - The सार्वधातुक forms of आशीर्लिङ्गलकार can also use अङ् as गणविकरणप्रत्यय.
3.1.86.sa: वेदानाम् विषये - आशीर्लिङ्गलकारस्य सार्वधातुकेषु रूपेषु शप्-विकरणस्य अपवादरूपेण अङ्-प्रत्ययः अपि दृश्यते ।
3.1.86.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.87.v: The ल denoting the agent, when the action affecting the agent is similar to the action which affects the object, is treated as if it were a ल denoting the object.

3.1.88.v: The agent of the verb तप् 'to heat', becomes similar to the object, only when the object is the word तपस् itself.

3.1.89.v: The affix यक् -- सार्वधातुके यक् [[3.1.67]],and चिण् -- अचः कर्मकर्तरि [[3.1.62]] are not used in the reflexive voice of the verbs दुह् 'to milk', स्नु 'to fall in drops' and नम् 'to bow.

3.1.90.v: The affix श्यन् comes after the roots कुष् 'to pull' and रञ्ज 'to colour' in the reflexive voice, according to the opinion of Eastern Grammarians and these verbs take the affixes of परस्मैपद ।

3.1.91.v: As far as the end of the Third Chapter reckoning from the present sūtra, the affixes treated of are to be understood as coming after some verbal root. (Note: This is an अधिकार सूत्र। All these verbal affixes are broadly classified as कृत् and कृत्य affixes)
3.1.91.sa: अस्मात् सूत्रात् आरभ्य तृतीयाध्यायस्य समाप्तिपर्यन्तम् ये प्रत्ययाः वक्ष्यन्ते ते धातोः भवेयुः ।
3.1.91.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.92.v: In the Third Chapter of Grammar, referring to verbal roots, the word implied in a term exhibited in the Locative -7th-case, is called उपपद or dependant word.
3.1.92.e: The words referenced by the सप्तमीस्थ words of the sutras in this धात्वधिकार get the term 'उपपद'.
3.1.92.sa: 'धातोः' अस्मिन् अधिकारे विद्यमानेषु सूत्रेषु यः शब्दः सप्तमीविभक्त्या निर्दिश्यते, तेन वाचितं पदम्  'उपपद'संज्ञकं भवति ।
3.1.92.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.1.93.v: In this portion of the sūtras in which there is a reference to verbal roots, any affix except तिङ् - tense affixes, is called कृत् ।

3.1.94.v: In this portion of the sūtras, in which there is reference to verbal roots, an affix which is calculated to debar a general one, not being of the same form, optionally debars it; but not so in the case of feminine affixes -- स्त्रियां क्तिन् [[3.3.94]].

3.1.95.v: From this sūtra up to ण्वुल्तृचौ [[3.1.133]] all the affixes treated will get the name कृत्य।

3.1.96.v: The affixes तव्यत् , तव्य and अनीयर् come after the verbal roots.

3.1.97.v: The affix यत् comes after a root that ends in a vowel.

3.1.98.v: The affix यत् comes after a root which ends in a labial letter preceded by a short अ।

3.1.99.v: The affix यत् comes after roots शकॢ 'to be able' and सह 'to bear'.

3.1.100.v: The affix यत् comes after roots गद् 'to eat', मद् 'to be mad', चर् 'to go, to eat' and यम् 'to restrain', when these roots do not take any preposition.

3.1.101.v: The words अवद्य , पण्य , वर्या are irregularly formed, having the sense of 'condemnable', saleable' and unobstructable', respectively.

3.1.102.v: The word वह्यं is irregularly formed when the meaning of the word is an instrument of carrying.

3.1.103.v: The word अर्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'lord' and a वैश्य।

3.1.104.v: The word उपसर्या is irregularly formed when meaning what has reached the time favourable to conception or ripe for fruition.

3.1.105.v: The word अजर्यंम् 'imperishable' is irregularly formed when qualifying the word संगतम् 'friendship' expressed or understood.

3.1.106.v: After the root वद् 'to speak', governing a case-inflected word as its उपपद and not having a preposition annexed to it, there comes the affix क्यप् also.

3.1.107.v: After the root भू 'to be', in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition, the affix क्यप् is used to denote condition - भाव।

3.1.108.v: After the root हनु 'to kill' when in construction with a case-inflected word as its उपपद and when used without a preposition comes the affix क्यप् in denoting condition and the letter त is the substitute of its final.

3.1.109.v: After the verbs इ 'to go', स्तु 'to praise', शास् 'to govern', वृ 'to respect' and जुष् 'to please' comes the affix क्यप्।

3.1.110.v: After the verbs having the penultimate short ऋ , the affix क्यप् is used, with the exception of the verbs कॢप् 'to be able' and वृत् 'to hurt'.

3.1.111.v: The affix क्यप् is used after the root खन 'to dig' and long ई is substituted for the final of the root.

3.1.112.v: The affix क्यप् is used after the root भृञ् 'to bear' when not used as a name.

3.1.113.v: The affix क्यप् is optionally used after the verb सृज् 'to cleanse'.

3.1.114.v: The words राजसूय , सूर्य , मृषोद्य , रुच्य , कुप्य , कृष्ट , पच्य and अव्यथ्य irregularly formed by the addition of the affix क्यप्।

3.1.115.v: The words भिद्य and उद्ध्यौ are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when meaning 'river'.

3.1.116.v: The words पुष्य and सिद्ध्य् are irregularly formed by the affix क्यप् , when used as names of asterisms.

3.1.117.v: When the words विपूय , विनीय and जित्या are irregularly formed they mean 'the मुञ्ज grass', 'the sediment' and 'the plough', respectively.

3.1.118.v: The word ग्रह 'to seize', preceded by the prepositions प्रति and अपि , takes the affix क्यप् in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.1.119.v: The root ग्रह 'to seize' takes the affix क्यप् when it means a 'word', a 'dependent', 'outside' or a 'partisan'.

3.1.120.v: After the verbs कृञ् 'to do' and वृष् 'to rain', the affix क्यप् is optionally used.

3.1.121.v: The word युग्यम् is irregularly formed meaning 'a vehicle'.

3.1.122.v: Optionally the word अमावस्या is irregular.

3.1.123.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the following words are found, which are formed irregularly - निष्टर्क्य , देवहूय , प्रणीय , उन्नीय , उच्छिष्य , मर्य , स्तर्या , ध्वर्य , खन्य , खान्य , देवयज्या , आपृच्छ्य , प्रतिषीव्य , ब्रह्मवाद्य , भाव्य , स्ताव्य , and पचाय्यपृड।

3.1.124.v: The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in ऋ (long or short) or in a consonant.

3.1.125.v: The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in the letter उ - long or short, when the sense is that of 'necessity'.

3.1.126.v: The affix ण्यत् comes after the verbs आसु 'to distill', यु 'to join', वप 'to sow', रप् 'to speak distinctly', लप् 'to prate', अप् 'to be ashamed' and चम 'to drink'.

3.1.127.v: The word आनाय्यः is irregularly formed when meaning 'impermanent'.

3.1.128.v: The word प्रणाय्य is irregularly formed when meaning 'disapproved'.

3.1.129.v: The words पाय्य , सान्नाय्य , निकाय्य and धाय्या are irregularly formed meaning 'a measure', 'an oblation to fire', 'a dwelling' and 'a sacrificial prayer', respectively.

3.1.130.v: The words कुण्डपाय्यः and संचाय्यः are irregularly formed meaning 'a sacrifice'.

3.1.131.v: The words परिचाय्यः , पचाय्य and समूह्याः are irregularly formed when they are names of fire.

3.1.132.v: The words चित्य and ग्निचित्य are also irregularly formed.

3.1.133.v: The affixes ण्वुल् (अक्) and तृच् (तृ) are placed after all verbal roots, expressing the agent.

3.1.134.v: After the verbs classed as नन्द 'to be happy', ग्रह 'to take' and पच् 'to cook' there are the affixes ल्यु (अन), णिनि (इन्) and अच (अ) respectively.

3.1.135.v: After a verb ending in a consonant but preceded by इ , उ or ऋ -long or short, and after the verbs ज्ञा 'to know', श्री 'to please' and कॄ 'to scatter', comes the affix क (अ)।

3.1.136.v: Also after a verb ending in long आ when there is a preposition along with it, the affix क is placed.

3.1.137.v: The affix श (अ) is used after the roots पा 'to drink', घ्रा 'to smell', ध्मा 'to blow' and धेट् 'to suck' and दृश् 'to see' when there is a preposition along with these roots.

3.1.138.v: The affix श is used after the verbs - धारि , पारि , वेदि , उदेजि , चेति , साति and साहि , when used without a preposition.

3.1.139.v: The affix श is optionally used after the root दा 'to give' and धा 'to hold', when used without a preposition.

3.1.140.v: After the verbs beginning with ज्वल 'to shine' and ending with कस 'to go', when used without a preposition, the affix ण is optionally used.

3.1.141.v: The affix ण is also used after the verbs - श्यै 'to go', verbs ending in a long भा , व्यद् 'to pierce', आस्रु 'to pain', संत्रु 'to flow', अतीण् 'to pass on', अवसा 'to complete', अवह 'to take away', लिह 'to lick', श्लिष 'to embrace' and श्वस 'to breathe'.

3.1.142.v: The affix ण is used after the verbs दु 'to burn' and नी 'to lead', when used without a preposition.

3.1.143.v: The affix ण is optionally used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize'.

3.1.144.v: The affix क is used after the verb ग्रह 'to seize' when the agent so expressed denotes a house.

3.1.145.v: The affix ष्वुन् (अक्) comes after a verb when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.

3.1.146.v: The affix थकन् (थक) comes after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed, denotes an artist.

3.1.147.v: The affix ण्युट् is also used after the verb गै 'to sing' when the agent so expressed denotes an artist.

3.1.148.v: After the verb हा , also the affix ण्युट् is used when the agent so expressed denotes 'rice' and 'time'.

3.1.149.v: After the verbs प्रु 'to go', सृ 'to move', स्रु 'to flow' and लू 'to cut', the affix वुन् is used, when repitition is meant.

3.1.150.v: The affix वुन् is applied after all verbs when Benediction is intended.
